head.title: Ana’s Bakery · Albanian Bakery & Cafe in Clearwater, FL | Byrek, Baklava & Custom Cakes
head.description: Ana's Bakery, Clearwater FL: fresh byrek, baklava, macarons and custom cakes made daily at 1441 S Belcher Rd. 5.0 stars, 392 Google reviews. Call (727) 286-6140.
head.og_description: Byrek, baklava, macarons and custom cakes, baked fresh every day. 5.0 stars on Google.

jsonld.name: Ana’s Bakery
jsonld.description: Albanian bakery and cafe in Clearwater, Florida serving byrek, baklava, custom cakes, macarons and coffee, baked fresh daily.

parrafo.es: En el 1441 S Belcher Rd horneamos byrek, baklava, macarons y pasteles de cumpleaños cada día, junto con café turco de verdad. Todo preparado a mano, con la misma receta familiar de siempre.
parrafo.en: At 1441 S Belcher Rd we bake byrek, baklava, macarons and birthday cakes every day, alongside real Turkish coffee. Everything made by hand, with the same family recipe as always.

hero.imagen_alt: Storefront of Ana's Bakery in Clearwater, Florida, with the lit sign and OPEN neon

parrafo_1.es: Ana's Bakery abrió sus puertas en Belcher Road para traer a Clearwater los sabores de la repostería albanesa: byrek horneado en el momento, baklava, macarons y pasteles de cumpleaños que se preparan a pedido.
parrafo_1.en: Ana's Bakery opened its doors on Belcher Road to bring Albanian-style baking to Clearwater: byrek baked fresh daily, baklava, macarons and birthday cakes made to order.

parrafo_2.es: No hay atajos: cada bandeja de byrek, cada bandeja de baklava y cada pastel sale de la cocina de la tienda el mismo día que se sirve. Es la razón por la que 392 personas le dieron 5.0 estrellas en Google.
parrafo_2.en: There are no shortcuts here: every tray of byrek, every batch of baklava and every cake comes out of the shop's own kitchen the same day it's served. That is why 392 people gave it 5.0 stars on Google.

texto.es: Pasa por 1441 S Belcher Rd o llámanos al (727) 286-6140 para preguntar qué hay fresco ese día.
texto.en: Stop by 1441 S Belcher Rd or call (727) 286-6140 to ask what's fresh that day.

texto.es: Byrek de espinaca, carne y cebolla o tomate y cebolla, baklava, macarons, tiramisú, cheesecake y más, siempre horneados ese mismo día.
texto.en: Spinach, meat and onion or tomato and onion byrek, baklava, macarons, tiramisu, cheesecake and more, always baked that same day.

texto.es: Para cumpleaños y celebraciones, cuéntanos el diseño y la fecha: cada pastel se cotiza según el tamaño y la decoración.
texto.en: For birthdays and celebrations, tell us the design and the date: every cake is quoted based on size and decoration.

texto.es: Abierto los 7 días de la semana, de 7 AM a 6 PM, para que tu pedido salga del horno y llegue directo a tu mesa.
texto.en: Open seven days a week, 7 AM to 6 PM, so your order goes straight from the oven to your table.

nota.es: Macarons y café tienen precio fijo en el mostrador. Los pasteles personalizados se cotizan según el diseño: llama o pasa por la tienda.
nota.en: Macarons and coffee have set prices at the counter. Custom cakes are quoted based on the design: call or stop by the shop.

texto.es: Pasteles de cumpleaños, baby shower y celebraciones, decorados a mano. Cuéntanos la fecha y el diseño y te damos el precio.
texto.en: Birthday, baby shower and celebration cakes, decorated by hand. Tell us the date and the design and we'll give you the price.

texto.es: Espinaca, carne y cebolla, o tomate y cebolla: el byrek albanés hojaldrado que se hornea cada mañana en la tienda.
texto.en: Spinach, meat and onion, or tomato and onion: the flaky Albanian byrek baked fresh in-house every morning.

texto.es: Baklava, macarons a $1.50, tiramisú, cheesecake y la zupa de la casa a $5.00, siempre frescos en la vitrina.
texto.en: Baklava, macarons at $1.50, tiramisu, cheesecake and the house zupa at $5.00, always fresh in the case.

texto.es: Café turco, cappuccino, frappé, café americano y té caliente, preparados al momento para acompañar tu byrek.
texto.en: Turkish coffee, cappuccino, frappe, American coffee and hot tea, made fresh to go with your byrek.

pie.es: ¿Buscas algo que no está en la vitrina? Pregunta por pedidos especiales con aviso previo.
pie.en: Looking for something that's not in the case? Ask about special orders with advance notice.

items.quote: Absolute gem in Clearwater, Florida. First time visiting and it was delicious. The byrek, shendetli, zuppa was amazing but the most amazing were the people owning the shop. We really enjoyed the food and also took some byrek home for our family to try and they absolutely loved it. Thank you Ana's Bakery. We will definitely be back

My co-worker is from Albania and invited me to come here. I really enjoyed my time here. Very clean and everything is fresh. I opted for a cappuccino and a spinach and feta cheese pastry. It was delicious!
The byrek reminded me of the byrek my grandma used to do! My favourite was the feta cheese and ricotta, and from the dessert Napolitana was very light and delicious.
Beautiful food beautiful service and options here. Wonderful kick from a perfect caramel Macchiato and the best breakfast I've been craving in Pinellas County. I will be back again and again.
